issues.issue: This period is correct for FY2024, but Naper_FY2025.json also holds the 10/1/23-9/30/24 statement (fiscal_year_end 2024-09-30), so the workbooks may count the same year twice. Only a person can decide this, and decision_needed[] doesn't include it.
